question: What was the name of the person who has been elected as the Chair of the 62ⁿd session of the United Nations Commission for Social Development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ruchira Kamboj.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ruchira Kamboj has been elected as the Chair of the 62nd session of the United Nations Commission for Social Development held from February 5–14, **2024,** at the United Nations Headquarters in New York.
 
• She is an experienced **diplomat,** having served in various roles in India’s Ministry of External Affairs.
 
• Kamboj is committed to addressing **critical social issues**, including poverty alleviation, employment, and social integration.
 
• She **strongly focuses on gender equality** and the empowerment of women and children in her policy initiatives.
 
• Her leadership position reflects **India's active role in international organizations** and its commitment to social development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BM Vinod Kumar**

 
 
• A seasoned **diplomat with experience in international relations**, particularly in the field of trade and commerce.
 
• He has served in various capacities at the** Indian Embassy **in different countries, contributing to India’s bilateral relations.
 
• Known for his expertise in **economic diplomacy and trade negotiations.**
 
• Has participated in numerous international forums addressing trade and development issues.
 
 
 
• **Satinder Kumar Lambah**
 
 
• A retired Indian diplomat, known for his extensive experience in foreign policy and security issues.
 
• **Former Secretary (East) in the Ministry of External Affairs** and **India’s Special Envoy for Disarmament.**
 
• Contributed to various discussions and papers on international relations and strategic studies.
 
• Often** engaged in think tanks and advisory boards** focusing on foreign policy.
 
 
 
• **Nirupama Menon Rao**
 
 
• A former Indian **Foreign Secretary and Ambassador to the United States and China,** with a strong diplomatic background.
 
• Advocate for women's rights and empowerment in her diplomatic and public service roles.
 
• Actively participates in discussions and seminars on international relations, **focusing on South Asian politics.**
 
• Writes on foreign policy and international affairs, contributing to various publications and forums.
